# Memo 3 — Inaccurate quotations

**Re:** Quotation errors of every kind

## One word changed

Section 162(a) allows a deduction for "all the ordinary and reasonable expenses
paid or incurred during the taxable year in carrying on any trade or business."

## Right section, wrong subdivision

Section 162(b) provides that "[t]here shall be allowed as a deduction all the
ordinary and necessary expenses paid or incurred during the taxable year in
carrying on any trade or business."

## Attributed to the wrong section entirely

Section 263(a) provides that "gross income means all income from whatever source
derived, including (but not limited to) the following items."

## Fabricated

Section 61(a) states that "all receipts of a commercial character shall be
included in the computation of taxable profit for the year of receipt."

## Unattributed

> a citizen or resident of the United States
